title: Annotatio IV §.I open: History of the true Eucharistic sentence — foundation in Institution words
pass_a_gloss: §. I. At last we gird ourselves to composing in brief the History of the true Eucharistic Sentence, whose beginning as well as foundation we judge is to be placed in the very words of the Institution of the Sacred Supper, and we observe placed there by Christ Himself, saying, This is my body, This is my blood.
pass_b_english: §.I: we now briefly write the history of that true Eucharistic sentence.
Its beginning and foundation sit in the Institution words themselves — This is my body, This is my blood — placed there by Christ.
source_text: §. I. Tandem Historiæ de vera Sententia Eucharistica per compendium condendæ, accingimur, cujus ut primordium, ita fundamentum in ipsis Institutionis S. Cœnæ verbis & collocandum arbitramur, & à Christo ipso collocatum advertimus, dicente, Hoc est corpus meum, Hic est sanguis meus.

lemmas.gloss: in the words of the Institution of the Sacred Supper
